authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the R-6 process-death cleanup and R-10 expiry-limb initial states from permission-truth-tables.v9 as leftover beyond OBL-FX-AUTHORING's fourteen FX classes. It does not author journal bytes. It does not invent an expiry-age number. It does not invent a cleanup-bound number. It does not evaluate expiry by wall-clock now. It does not execute R-6 or R-10. It does not close OBL-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-105. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of the G09-named R-6 and R-10 limbs without inventing journal or clock envelopes. G09 v3 names expiry limb R-10 and process-death cleanup R-6. Those are leftover beyond the fourteen FX classes. This catalog records the named initial states.

pttV9.r6Verbatim: PROCESS DEATH mid-cleanup. Recovery re-runs cleanup from the journal. Every inverse is idempotent by its effect class's own declaration, so re-running is safe by construction. Cleanup's bound is measured from the recovery, and exhausting it journals a residual rather than looping.
pttV9.r10Verbatim: An EXPIRY falling between acceptance and commit-intent. Expiry is materialized as a journaled record at the sequence where the host observes it, and it behaves exactly as REV from that point. It is NOT evaluated by comparing a wall-clock expiry timestamp against a wall-clock now at commit time.

g09v3.role: Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed. Not applied. Names R-10 expiry limb and R-6 process-death cleanup. Not FX-15.
